how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Central Bank of India Company Secretary Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.centralbank.bank.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Central Bank of India Company Secretary Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.centralbank.bank.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central Bank of India for hiring a qualified Company Secretary in Senior Management Grade Scale V on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Company Secretary in this recruitment drive released by the Central Bank of India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form is 10-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address on or before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) with a valid ICSI membership number and required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the post-qualification experience required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a minimum post-qualification experience of 7 years completed in a listed company, preferably a Bank, NBFC, or financial services company.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years. Candidates should verify their age eligibility according to the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for all candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories of candidates is Rs. 1180/-, which is inclusive of Rs. 1000 application fee and Rs. 180 GST.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply through offline mode by downloading the application form, filling it out completely, attaching required documents, and sending it by post.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent to the Chief General Manager, Central Bank of India, Human Capital Department - R&P, 17th Floor, Chandermukhi, Nariman Point, Mumbai - 400021.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the shortlisting of applications received followed by a personal interview conducted by the Central Bank of India.
